- what to do?
    - ~change [python dependency](https://github.com/hwchase17/langchain/blob/master/pyproject.toml#LL15C24-L15C24) to 3.10 or later~

- Thank you for checking out this issue. If there are anything more to check, I would be glad to help.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Latest pydantic==1.10.8 fixed this issue in [here](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/5826). Langchain needs no update because pydantic dependency is > 1 in [here](https://github.com/participant24/langchain/blob/master/pyproject.toml#L16).

Just in case, this is how to check the update.
```
docker run -it --rm python:3.9-bullseye bash
pip install langchain
python -m "import langchain"
pip freeze | grep pydantic
```
